## Batch 17 complete

Authored eight A items and two examples, including the exact known-variance one-sided z-test power and minimum-size result, its nonpositive-quantile-sum case, and a two-sided power calculation that includes both tails. The finite-candidate search is separate from the general least-feasible-size specification.

The A/B pages, item manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch dependency evidence, and notes are in place: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/statistical-models-and-experiments/power-and-sample-size-planning.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/statistical-models-and-experiments/power-and-sample-size-planning-examples.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-17.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-17.proof-contracts.json), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-17.coverage.json), [cross-batch evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-17.cross-batch-dependencies.json), and [authoring notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-17.notes.md).

Checks passed: strict proof contracts for 10/10 items, precheck with 8 passes and 2 not applicable, proof-layout with 24 steps and zero defects, source fetch verification for all 3 sources, and batch-local dependency levels for all 10 items. All ten Step-1 records are `ready` with current hashes; those records are authoring readiness, not independent approval.

## Run-wide blockers

The full-run dependency check reports existing errors outside Batch 17 in `lem-bounded-predictable-counting-integral-pathwise-identity`, `lem-cox-partial-likelihood-hessian-convergence`, `lem-cox-score-martingale-replacement`, `thm-cox-score-limit-and-estimator-linearization`, `cor-cox-partial-likelihood-asymptotic-normality`, `def-random-field-stationarity-covariance-and-variogram`, `lem-random-field-covariance-kernel-is-positive-semidefinite`, `thm-gaussian-random-field-existence-from-a-positive-semidefinite-kernel`, `thm-order-two-field-variogram-is-conditionally-negative-definite`, `thm-continuous-stationary-field-covariance-has-bochner-measure`, and `ex-covariance-kernel-and-intrinsic-variogram-checks`.

The batch dependency check also reports the shared artifact as stale: the dispatch input hash differs from its recorded hash. I left that owner-controlled artifact and all other batches unchanged.
